guides.title: Introduction
guides.content:
§lWelcome.§r 

My youthful vigilance has escaped me. I have left this home's stewardship to whoever may need its shelter.§r

Find me down south,
    §4- Lt. Kaamos,
Northern Watch Corps§r

guides.title: The Boiler
guides.content:
§6Heat§r is essential to surivival.

One must use a §lboiler§r to warm themselves during the colder seasons. Requires both §2fuel§r and §4redstone§r.

guides.title: Cooking
guides.content:
Cooking both calms the nerves and aids in helps in keeping a §nbalanced diet§r. One must fuel and light their stove.

Electricity might as well not exist this far north.

guides.title: Some Horrible Smell
guides.content:
I feel a wind of death so strong it is nearly driving me mad.

Some §4rotten carcass§r...

guides.title: Double Dreams
guides.content:
I had another double dream last night...
    ...As if I had lived an entire day...




I feel as if I have written this entry a thousand times and more.

guides.title: Butchering
guides.content: To butcher a carcass, hang it on a hook. Use a §ncleaver§r to drain it of blood, then skin it with a §nskinning knife§r. Finally, carve it with a cleaver.

guides.title: Maps
guides.content:
Maps are mandatory for an adventure. This far north, terrain is repetitive.

§nDo not§r get lost.

guides.title: Tanning
guides.content:
To tan skins into leather, §e§3salt§r§r them. With a §1wet§r rag or sponge, clean the salted skin. Last, leave the skin out to dry

It is reccomended to process skins in parallel.

guides.title: The Livestock
guides.content:
When I first arrived here, the herds were plentiful. Now, most seem to have disappeared. There seems to be §osomething§r happening in the woods.

Tomorrow, I will investigate.

guides.title: Salt
guides.content: Salt is obtained by evaporating §9water§r in a §8basin§r.

guides.title: Trees
guides.content:
Do §lnot§r get crushed by a falling §2tree§r.

This should be self-explanatory.

guides.title: Guns
guides.content:
§8Guns§r are a necessity this far north. Tehy are they great for hunting and help fend off other...
      ...§4threats§r...
...

Guns require §9ammunition§r.

guides.title: Ammunition
guides.content:
§9Ammunition§r is a precious resource. It is made with §8gunpowder§r and metal.

Do not it use frivolously.

guides.title: Gunpowder
guides.content:
§8Gunpowder§r is the basis of all explosives. It is produced with §lsaltpeter§r, §lsulfur§r, and §lcoal§r.

Sometimes explosion craters are found in the forest. Thus, there may be an alternative source.

guides.title: Sulfur
guides.content:
Sulfur is a naturally generating ore.

It can be brewed into corrosive acids and mixed with §4fuel§r and an §1oxidizer§r to yield §8gunpowder§r.

guides.title: Saltpeter
guides.content: Saltpeter (KNO₃) is a strong oxidizer derived from fermented organic matter. It must be brewed and filtered in order to be used. Mix with sulfur and §4fuel§r to yield §8gunpowder§r.
